description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RequiredParameterTrait' that provides methods to check for the presence of required parameters in a given array. It is part of the 'league/oauth2-client' library and helps ensure that necessary parameters are supplied during OAuth2 client operations.

methods.name: checkRequiredParameter
methods.description: Checks if a specific parameter exists in the provided array; throws BadMethodCallException if missing.

methods.name: checkRequiredParameters
methods.description: Checks for multiple required parameters in the array by invoking checkRequiredParameter for each.
